title: Chunin Exam
body:
Syntax: exam

Description: Enters the Forest of Death for the Chunin Exam, required to advance from Genin to Chunin. Requires level 35 and at least 25 completed missions.

You receive a Heaven Scroll (VNUM 20800) or Earth Scroll (VNUM 20801). Defeat animals and rival ninja to obtain the other scroll. With both scrolls, reach the central tower (VNUM 357) and ASK PROCTOR EXAM or SUBMIT SCROLLS. The proctor takes the scrolls and sends you to the arena (VNUM 670). Hear the Third Hokage's speech; answer YES to summon your final opponent, then ATTACK it or use a jutsu to begin. Answer NO to postpone, or READY to hear the speech again. Win to become Chunin and receive a headband. Old Hell Scrolls still count as Earth Scrolls.

Leaving with LEAVE CONFIRM or dying fails the attempt. Re-enter by typing EXAM.

Date: 2026-11-12
